name: checked_arithmetic_invariants

test_list.description: Grid construction and access reject overflow and out-of-range coordinates rather than returning zero or ignoring writes.
Known independent insert, delete and relabel costs remain exact.
Bounded property-generated unary trees match an independent Levenshtein oracle and remain symmetric.
The public exact metric preserves known declaration rename and subtree insertion distances.
The existing independent repo-map budget regression confirms rendered map estimates do not exceed the requested budget.
The existing skeleton property regression confirms bounded signatures remain valid UTF-8.

inputs.name: tree_pair
inputs.description: Small valid source trees with known unit edit costs.

inputs.name: dimensions
inputs.description: Valid and invalid dense grid coordinates including overflow-sized values.

inputs.name: budgets
inputs.description: Zero, one, and exact-fit budgets used to verify output contracts.

output_description: Exact arithmetic and indexed state preserve semantic results or fail closed on invariant violations.
